title: Profile
pages.subtitle: Accounting, advisory and growth services for growing businesses

title: About
Lumen Ridge
pages.lead: Lumen Ridge helps owners run a business with clean books, clear numbers and fewer surprises.
columns: We started in 2016 as a two-person accounting practice. Today a team of 40 serves more than 300 businesses across retail, trade, services and manufacturing.
Each client has one named partner and a small team that knows the file. We answer in plain words and we tell you what to do next, not only what happened.

title: Our
Leadership
pages.lead: Two partners lead the firm. Both still work on client files every week.

people.name: Alex Moreno
people.bio: Alex leads audit and advisory work. Alex has 18 years in practice and in industry finance roles.

people.name: Sam Okafor
people.bio: Sam leads the growth and digital team. Sam built the marketing function of two regional brands.

title: Mission, Vision
and Values
pages.mission: To give every owner numbers they trust and advice they can act on.
pages.vision: To be the first call for a growing business when a decision is about money.

title: What Our
Clients Say

hero.text: Lumen Ridge took over our books in the middle of a hard year. Within one quarter we knew our real margins and fixed two loss-making lines.

quotes.text: Month-end used to take three weeks. Now we close in five days and the reports arrive before the board meeting.
Clear advice, fast replies and no jargon. They feel like part of our own team.
